avoid_supplements.name: St. John's Wort
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 induction reduces colchicine levels; P-gp induction decreases bioavailability
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid concurrent use; consider alternative herbal supplements

avoid_supplements.name: Grapefruit seed extract
avoid_supplements.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition increases colchicine concentrations and toxicity risk
avoid_supplements.action: Discontinue supplement; allow 48-72 hour washout before colchicine initiation

avoid_supplements.name: Goldenseal
avoid_supplements.mechanism: Contains berberine; CYP3A4 inhibition elevates colchicine levels
avoid_supplements.action: Avoid use; increased risk of colchicine-induced myopathy and neuropathy

caution_supplements.name: Echinacea
caution_supplements.mechanism: Mild CYP3A4 induction may slightly reduce colchicine levels
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for reduced efficacy; dosage adjustment rarely needed

caution_supplements.name: Milk thistle (Silymarin)
caution_supplements.mechanism: Weak CYP3A4 inhibition may moderately increase colchicine exposure
caution_supplements.action: Monitor for adverse effects; counsel on signs of toxicity

avoid_foods.name: Grapefruit and grapefruit juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: Potent CYP3A4 inhibition significantly increases colchicine bioavailability and plasma concentrations, increasing myopathy and neurotoxicity risk
avoid_foods.action: Complete avoidance required; single glass of juice can inhibit CYP3A4 for 24+ hours

avoid_foods.name: Pomegranate juice
avoid_foods.mechanism: CYP3A4 inhibition may elevate colchicine levels to toxic range

caution_foods.name: High-fat meals
caution_foods.mechanism: May increase colchicine absorption and delay gastric emptying, potentially elevating peak concentrations
caution_foods.action: Separate colchicine dosing from large fatty meals by at least 2 hours when possible

monitoring_notes: Monitor for signs of colchicine toxicity including muscle weakness, myalgia, neuropathy, diarrhea, and elevated creatinine kinase, particularly in patients with renal impairment (CrCl <30 mL/min) or concurrent P-gp and CYP3A4 inhibitors. Counsel patients to report all supplements, herbal products, and dietary changes to their pharmacist.
